verdict.rationale: Navan documents a public developer API with OAuth 2.0 client-credentials auth, retrieval/update endpoints across expense, cards, receipts, webhooks, and async job status (navan-docs-2, navan-docs-4, navan-docs-23), confirmed by a live probe of the docs portal. This is a genuine public API for driving the product programmatically, not just an MCP wrapper. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer reports validating the API in production, and more detail on rate limits/SDKs.
